headline: Last session: Sensex fell 289 points on inflation concerns, though Indian markets extended gains for a 3rd week.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on market sentiment during Friday's session.
Global tech volatility increased following a 13% weekly crash in Nvidia shares after Jensen Huang's exit.
PSU Banks led sectoral gainers, supporting the broader weekly rally.
Positive commentary on India's export targets helped sustain medium-term market momentum.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex slipped 289 points as inflation concerns dampened investor confidence.
Despite Friday's loss, both Nifty 50 and Sensex extended their weekly rally for the third straight week.
Union Minister Piyush Goyal stated India is well on track to achieve the $1 trillion export target for this fiscal.
Global tech systems experienced disruptions due to a Microsoft outage that was later restored.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 16 November.
On the last trading session, Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns weighed on domestic equities.
Despite the Friday drop, Indian markets extended their weekly rally for a third consecutive week, led by PSU bank stocks.
